# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Nocturne: Veil Juggle as a mobile-first browser canvas arcade keep-up game. Preserve the source mechanic: one circular object falls under gravity, tap/click within a forgiving circular hitbox kicks it upward with horizontal impulse based on tap offset, score increments by one per valid hit, wall bounces dampen motion, and ground contact ends the run with restart.

Theme every safe surface around: Create a deterministic creative remix in a Harry Potter inspired style, centered on a dark vigilante, but make it cinematic. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.

Use a dark vigilante guarding a forbidden magical academy rooftop, a cursed prophecy orb as the focal object, "Veil Lashes" as score, cinematic moonlit castle/rune backgrounds, purple-gold shadow particles, and compact mobile HUD/buttons.

# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: single-object arcade juggling / keep-up canvas game
- objective: tap or click the falling ball before it reaches the ground; each valid hit increments score by one
- input model: mouse down or touchstart on the active playfield, with native button clicks preserved for menu CTAs
- core loop: start run, gravity pulls the circular object down, player taps within a 1.5x radius hitbox, object kicks upward and sideways, score rises, loop repeats until ground contact
- fail/friction state: wall bounces damp horizontal velocity, gravity increases downward velocity, game over occurs when the object touches the bottom of the viewport

## Protected Mechanic Truth
- Gravity .5, friction .99, bounce damping .7, kick force -15, side impulse from tap offset, angular velocity from tap offset, wall bounce, score +1 per valid hit, fail on ground contact, restart reset.

## Remix Trajectory
Create a deterministic creative remix in a Harry Potter inspired style, centered on a dark vigilante, but make it cinematic. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.

The remixed game is Nocturne: Veil Juggle, a cinematic wizard-school-adjacent shadow vigilante ritual where the soccer ball becomes a cursed prophecy orb and each tap is a shadow lash.
